# `kernel/arch/news3400` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — news3400

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — news3400.

`config.mk` records no directly compiled sources here; the work is in the subdirectories.

Subdirectories: `bm/`, `conf/`, `fb/`, `hbdev/`, `if/`, `include/`, `iodev/`, `iop/`, `news3400/`, `newsos/`, `sio/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

子目录：`bm/`、`conf/`、`fb/`、`hbdev/`、`if/`、`include/`、`iodev/`、`iop/`、`news3400/`、`newsos/`、`sio/`。
